notes: A bridge, not a regular template: bridges are pulled only after a stretch of silence when nothing else qualifies, which is exactly the slot this belongs in. As an ordinary priority-1 line it lost to 150 others and fired four times in twelve hours. Says the waiting out loud instead of filling it with another price read -- a person watching a flat chart comments on the flatness, they do not re-read the price every twelve seconds.
variants: Still watching. Nothing's asking to be traded yet.

notes: Talks about the shape of the day rather than the price. Gives the stream a sense of somebody being present rather than a ticker with a voice.
variants: Sessions have a personality. This one's being polite.

notes: A narrator that notices it has been talking a lot is more tolerable than one that does not.

notes: Anchors the waiting to something concrete, so the filler still carries information.

notes: Early-stream warmth. A stream that opens straight into numbers feels like a machine turned on.
